item.text: The implementation now keeps every matching service, applies a clock seeded shuffle, and retries tunnel connectivity failures. I’ve also added focused tests for display deduplication and deterministic fallback, and I’m running the API, reverse tunnel, DB proxy, and `tsh` package tests now.

The first test run hit the container’s process/thread limit because four Go packages compiled concurrently. I’m stopping those runs and will rerun the packages sequentially with Go’s parallelism capped so the results reflect the code rather than resource exhaustion.

/bin/bash -lc "cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

## Objective
Resolve the HA database access issue: deduplicate database listings by service name and let the proxy retry shuffled same-name database servers over reverse tunnels.

## Completed
- Added "'`DeduplicateDatabaseServers`, stable name/host ID sorting, and host ID in database server log strings.
